programme.title: Talking Business
programme.desc: On Talking Business BBC presenters, based in the world's most dynamic cities, discuss with the most important and influential people from the world of business and finance, the key issues of the day. programme.title: China's Greatest Treasures
programme.desc: Compelling documentary series in which host, BBC Art Critic Alastair Sooke, embarks on an adventure of a lifetime, travelling through modern day China to examine how China's most important historic artefacts housed in museum collections across the country still influence and define the nation today. Subjects covered in the series include family and ancestors, calligraphy, food, technology, China's links with the rest of the world, and much more.

programme.title: Clive Myrie's Caribbean Adventure
programme.desc: Clive visits the bustling district of Vedado, the most modern and affluent part of Havana. He also learns how to make the perfect Cuban cocktail.

programme.title: The Climate Question
programme.desc: A global programme that reflects the variety of takes on climate change, how best to understand it and the world's attempts to avert it, temper it or adapt to it. It is not about questioning whether climate change is happening, it's about finding the best ways to respond to it. This is sharp-edged, analytical inquiry. Hard scrutiny, touched with a sense of adventure and discovery, and where we can find it, hope. It includes stories from across the world on why we find it so hard to save our own planet, and how we might change that.

programme.title: Top Wing
programme.desc: Best friends and cadets-in-training Swift, Penny, Rod, and Brody congregate at Top Wing Academy, where they learn what it takes to gain their wings and become rescue birds on Big Swirl Island. Swift is a blue jay and the fastest pilot at the academy; Penny, the only female in the group, is a penguin, and she is an expert at undersea life; Brody is a puffin who takes a more land approach, and Rod is a rooster who is ready to fly around Big Swirl Island in his all-terrain vehicle. The four friends are joined by their mentor Speedy, who helps the cadets on their different missions. "Top Wing" focuses on the importance of teamwork and the ability to successfully solve problems.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Watching too many ninja movies has brainwashed Leonard the koala. During the day, as he sleeps, he terrorizes everyone by sleepfighting (as opposed to sleepwalking). He makes the Rat King very angry by beating and humiliating him, and the oversized rodent is out for revenge. The penguins counter-program Leonard with a Lunacorn love movie marathon - is it enough to conquer all? // Private is left to babysit four adorable ducklings as the rest of the gang tries to crash a monster truck rally (unsuccessfully). The ducklings are a rowdy bunch and throw a party, inadvertently attracting party-crashing rats and wasps who attack the party food. Private and the ducklings become trapped in the lair with the food, and as the rats and wasps try to break in, Private must think fast - how can he combat both gangs at once?

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The penguins notice it's been quiet at night. Too quiet, something's amiss. The rest of the zoo animals have been sneaking out at night to spend time partying in the park! The plan to sneak out then return by morning to avoid getting caught by Alice is put in jeopardy when they run into the classic New York problem - a traffic jam in the tunnel. How in the world can a traffic jam get cleared out of the tunnel in time? // The penguins make a new friend in Dode the dodo bird, who they clone back into existence after a pesky bout of extinction. Having grown up with no natural enemies, Dode has no fear and it leads him to daredevilish behavior - the kind that can make you extinct over and over again. The penguins don't want to see this keep happening to their friend, they need to find a way to slow this crazy bird down!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: When her parents won't let her have french fries for every meal, Hazel wishes for unlimited fries. But Cosmo and Wanda fail to mention that eating so many magical fries would turn her into a potato! For help Cosmo, Wanda, and Hazel pay a visit to Mother Nature, where Hazel accidentally eats the prized "mother potato." Can she reconcile her fry fixation and get back in Mother Nature's good graces, or will Hazel have to face her wrath while stuck as a potato forever? // After Hazel and Marcus watch a scary movie Cosmo and Wanda lent them, paranormal incidents happen in the Wells home. Hazel wishes Marcus had a ghost tracking show to investigate. But Hazel, Cosmo, and Wanda learn the ghost is Ghost Pepper, a fairy actress whose spirit was trapped in the video tape. Fearing her capture will reveal fairies' existence, Hazel must convince Marcus to have an "exorcism" as a cover to send her back to Fairy World.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: When Hazel wishes to be 13 so that she can go see a PG-13 movie by herself, Cosmo and Wanda turn her into a teenager. They go the mall and have a blast doing "teenage things" while they wait for the movie. But, as a side effect of her wish, Hazel starts going through the fairy version of puberty: pasta puberty! As she struggles to deal with pesto pimples and mozzarella mood swings, Hazel wishes that Cosmo and Wanda would just get lost! They disappear, leaving Hazel to deal with the zany pasta puberty alone. // Hazel wishes to be a fairy to join Cosmo and Wanda at their Fairy Convention, but since it's against Da Rules, she settles on looking like a fairy instead. Once at the con, however, Hazel stumbles into the DMV booth and signs a "Fairy-fication" certificate, turning her into a real fairy! It also brings her anti-fairy into existence, who steals the certificate. Hazel, Cosmo, and Wanda must get the certificate back from her anti-fairy, or Hazel will be stuck as a fairy forever!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: Hazel, Jasmine, and Winn take an online BFF compatibility test. To their surprise, they fail! Nobody is fazed, except for Hazel, who overthinks the results and wishes that her friends could know exactly what's in her head. Cosmo and Wanda grant the wish, which lands all of them inside Hazel's mind. As they go through her mind like a museum, Hazel continues to overthink everything they see. Now, Hazel must overcome her negative thoughts and battle a literal mind worm to get her friends out! // When Hazel wishes she didn't have a gap in her teeth, the Tooth Fairy fills her gap with a talking tooth, Toothica. At first, she seems like a lot of fun, but when Toothica gets Hazel in trouble with her parents and plans a party in Hazel's mouth Hazel isn't invited to, Hazel decides she wants her gone! The Tooth Fairy, however, takes Toothica's side and is even set on honoring her at a gala. Hazel must find a way to prove Toothica is no good and get back her gap or be stuck with this rotten tooth forever.

programme.title: Tennis: Wimbledon. Highlights Day 12
programme.desc: Wimbledon is more than just a tennis tournament — it's a summer tradition, a slice of British culture, and one of the most iconic sporting events in the world. Held every year in London, England, usually in late June to early July, it's where the best tennis players on the planet come to battle it out on the famous grass courts of the All England Club. It's actually the oldest tennis tournament in the world, dating back to 1877, and it's still the only Grand Slam played on grass — the fastest and most unpredictable surface. That's part of what makes it so exciting. Matches are intense, fast-paced, and full of surprises. Wimbledon is packed with unique traditions that make it stand out. Players are required to wear all white on court — no exceptions. The crowd enjoys strawberries and cream, and you won't see flashy ads around the court — it's all about the game. And of course, there's the Royal Box, where you might spot celebrities or even members of the British Royal Family watching the action. From rising stars to tennis legends, everyone dreams of lifting the famous Wimbledon trophy. There's something magical about seeing players walk onto Centre Court, hearing the roar of the crowd, and witnessing moments that go down in sports history. Whether you're a tennis fan or just love great sports drama, Wimbledon is a must-watch — classy, thrilling, and full of unforgettable moments.

As Antoine becomes one of Mrs. Loiseau's students, he hides his new dream from his friends and family, fearing that they won't understand - this double life burdens him... Somewhere in between the gilded and uptight Parisian upper-class, and the harsh yet free-spirited and familiar suburbs he grew up in, Antoine will have to find his own voice.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

Unidentified crypto-creatures wander the state covered by millions of acres of dense wilderness and are known to lift and reposition trees with ease, create seismic activity with their minds, and even decapitate humans with one bite. Destination America's new series ALASKA MONSTERS travels with a team of native outdoorsmen, who call themselves the Midnight Sons, as they investigate the harsh Alaskan forest in a quest to uncover proof of frightening monsters thought to be living there.

programme.title: Ghost Asylum
programme.desc: Featuring a fearless crew on a quest to hunt down chain-rattling ghosts and scary apparitions in anyway they can, Ghost Asylum follows a passionate paranormal team in America, the Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) as they attempt to "trap ghosts" in the country's most haunted abandoned asylums, mental hospitals and sanitariums. Using their Sourthern charm and engineering knowledge to create supernatural inventions during their hunting to find ghosts or spirits of any kind. Their speciality is investigating the decaying, haunting and skin crawling mental institutions throughout the USA, warning viewers that they have permission to enter the most haunted buildings and that chasing ghosts without proper training "will get you killed", so don't try this at home.

programme.title: Ghost Loop
programme.desc: Follow a team of highly specialized paranormal experts, who help both the living and the dead and focus on a distinct type of haunting - ''ghost loop'', which happens when paranormal entities terrorize the living through endless and repetitive supernatural cycles, manifesting again and again in the same location. In each episode, paranormal investigator and medium Sean Austin, empath Kris Star, researcher and tech advisor Chris Califf, design specialist Eric Vitale, and tech support Matt Lytle, examine and research their client's property and history. Then, they formulate a plan they believe will help stop the haunting - whether it's building a 1900s-era train compartment, replicating a tavern from the 1850s, or constructing a 19th century baby's nursery. The team uses emotionally charged settings to draw out the entities in hopes that it will release the energy and break the loop once and for all.

programme.desc: Crime documentary series that examines homicide investigations using unfiltered footage, including body-cam, surveillance and interrogation-room footage, giving viewers a chance to follow a case from beginning to end. programme.title: Reasonable Doubt
programme.desc: As we all know, the initial verdict in a trial is not always the final outcome as many trial jury decisions are often overturned on appeal. However, the appeals process can take a significant amount of time to go through the system and also incur enormous costs on the individuals involved. This show follows the work of two investigators who re-examine the verdicts in contentious murder cases and assess the prospects of a successful appeal for the families of the people convicted of the crimes to determine if they should appeal or accept the verdict. Each episode traces the developments in the case, whether it be new evidence or witness testimony, which can then shed light on the innocence of the convicted person or show that, indeed, they are guilty of the crime and the verdict was correct.

programme.desc: Between 2005 and 2009, 8 women were murdered in the small town of Jennings, Louisiana. Although they all knew each other and their bodies were discovered in very similar circumstances, local police refuse to link the deaths. While some residents think the murders could be the work of a serial killer, others believe a darker conspiracy is at work and it may even include members of law enforcement. As they wait in vain for the investigation to move forward, the victim's families refuse to give up in their quest for justice. But with the investigation into all 8 deaths still open, police aren't talking, leaving the community haunted by the question: who killed the Jennings 8?

programme.title: High Speed Chase
programme.desc: A homicide suspect holding his own cousin hostage leads police on a chase through the city. Plus, a rookie cop chases a car deep into a Florida swamp.

programme.title: Street Outlaws
programme.desc: Reality series focuses on the amazing opportunity to dive into American street racing world. Look at how need for speed unites people and find out what adrenaline addicts are ready for in Oklahoma, unofficial capital of illegal street racing. Only top racers participate in the competition, they want to appear and stay at the A-list, everything they have to do is to try to squeeze as much performance out of their vehicles as possible.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: Drew Pritchard is a modern-day treasure hunter searching the back roads of the UK to discover hidden riches. With demanding customers, high turnover and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his crack team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life. Follow Drew and his crack team of specialists on a fascinating journey through the entire picking process – from the initial expedition, to renewal, and finally to resale. Showcasing his hard-earned knowledge and appreciation of salvage and restoration, each episode accompanies Drew on one big buying venture, such as setting off with an empty van and returning with a 20th century stained glass Gothic doorway from an Irish monastery – as well as the small, unpredictable adventures along the way. Simply discovering a treasure is only half the battle, as Drew must artfully convince owners to sell, and at his price. After a successful purchase, Drew and his team of experts bring the items back to Fabulously British Salvage, his tremendous 20,000 square foot showroom located in North Wales, to restore them to their original brilliance, before reselling them for profit. This is not an easy business, as any trip can feature the next great find or a bust that costs Drew and his team thousands. However, Drew's keen eye and adroit negotiating skills are second to none – his passion and drive for success make him one of the best in the business.

Then there appears several gold mining teams that compete with each other. In some episodes the teams move to South America. Admire the courage and determination of the team members in their unstoppable desire to become rich.

programme.title: Gold Rush
programme.desc: Gold Rush is a reality television series that follows the placer gold mining efforts of various family-run mining companies in boundless north of America. The series focuses on the work process in the conditions of permafrost and working relations between the participants. The show has 10 seasons altogether. In some episodes participants start the adventure and travel to Alaska to search for gold because of financial issues. They do not have any previous experience and have to learn on the job. Then there appears several gold mining teams that compete with each other. In some episodes the teams move to South America. Admire the courage and determination of the team members in their unstoppable desire to become rich.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown
programme.desc: Expedition Unknown chronicles the adventures of Josh Gates as he investigates iconic mysteries across the globe. Gates begins by interviewing key eyewitnesses and uncovering recent developments in the story, then springboards into a fully immersive exploration. This authentic, roughshod adventure leads Gates closer to the truth behind these unanswered global enigmas, such as the disappearance of Amelia Earhart's plane. Josh Gates is an adventurer and avid explorer with a unique brand of humor and passion for off-the-map excursions.

programme.title: Lost Monster Files
programme.desc: An unknown apex predator is preying on orcas and devouring whales off the frozen coast of Kodiak, Alaska, renewing fears of a prehistoric sea monster lurking in the icy depths of the northern Pacific Ocean. The team conducts an all-out hunt on land and sea using never-before-seen research from Sanderson's lost files -- can they identify the monster and uncover its lair before it strikes again?

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. Two complete strangers -- a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food and water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the two as they attempt to survive on their own for 21 days, with nothing but one personal item each and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, the couple quickly get to know each other -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude will serve them well.

programme.title: Scrappers
programme.desc: Trading scrap metal is like playing the stock market. From a small collection point, scrap metal goes a long way to collect and segregate before it reaches the furnace. The steel mills order batches of appropriately selected and prepared raw materials in a specified quantity and time. To trade scrap metal, you must have the ability to do business as well as luck. This program invites you to meet people who work in scrap yards all over Poland.

programme.title: Virgins
programme.desc: After years of missed connections and dating horror stories, these late bloomers are done playing it safe. They're stepping outside their comfort zones and taking big swings to finally go all the way, emotionally and physically. From navigating awkward first dates to exploring a bondage class and working with an intimacy partner they're putting it all on the line in hopes of finally sealing the deal.

programme.title: Match Me Abroad
programme.desc: After failing to find a soulmate in the US, Americans take the search overseas for a chance at happiness. Expert matchmakers pull out all the stops to connect these hopeful romantics to their one true love.

programme.title: Outdaughtered
programme.desc: 40 bottles a day, 420 diapers a week and feedings every three hours became the new normal for Danielle and Adam Busby when they welcomed home the only all-female set of quintuplets in the country. The family of three became a family of eight overnight, and TLC follows that incredible journey in the new series OutDaughtered. The series captures Danielle, Adam and their adorable 4-year-old daughter Blayke as they adjust to their new life, while trying to hold on to the identities and lives they had cultivated before the five new additions arrived. Following the hilarious and heartwarming antics of the entire family including Danielle's zany mother, Michelle, and her older twin sisters and their families, it's all hands on deck as the family relies on their tight-knit circle to make the most out of this incredible lifetime adventure.

programme.title: Doubling Down With the Derricos
programme.desc: Although sleepless nights, sibling squabbles and living rooms full of toe-tripping toys are a regular feature in any home with kids, what really happens when there are 14 of them under one roof? The series features a Las Vegas couple, Karen and Deon, who have had four sets of multiples back to back, with all of them being conceived naturally. The show will showcase the endearing couple who are all set to welcome a set of triplets while raising the elder 11, their ages ranging from 2 to 14. While Karen and Deon both have always wanted to have a big family, a ménage of 14 is not exactly they'd wished for. With both having inherited a gene pool that boasts a lineage of multiple births, the show will portray how the family celebrates and embraces all of life's hurdles and drama with open arms.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress
programme.desc: Delves into the heart of world famous Kleinfeld Bridal where the staff face immense pressure to help each bride find the dress if her dreams. Take a peak at the brides as they try on their dream dresses! It brings us up close and into the dressing room as brides prepare for their big day. Moms, bridesmaids and friends all express their opinions and often frustrate both bride and staff. In the end though, most brides find that "dream dress" and walk down with their grooms into wedded bliss.

programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress America
programme.desc: Looking for your perfect dress? Kleinfeld Bridal is the place for you. Follow brides as they head off on their search for the perfect wedding dress, no matter how big or small in the city of New York. Bringing their friends and family along to help them decide, will they girls trip to the store be an easy one? The brides are each assisted by a consultant during a private shopping event, the outcome being that all important dress.

The show explores the intricacy of working with your family, and their interpersonal relationships with other employees. programme.desc: American reality series, a follow-up spinoff of ''90 Day Fiancé'' that features couples who have applied for or received a K-1 visa (available uniquely to foreign fiancés of U.S. citizens) and have ninety days to marry each other, follows some of the most famous and interesting couples from the original show and documents the ups and downs of their relationships after they got married. For some of these couples, the real drama is just starting because they barely know each other and they have to battle critics, doubters, and various obstacles on their road to love. Some of the couples that are featured on the show are Danielle and Mohamed, Melanie and Devar, Loren and Alexei, Kyle and Noon, Brett and Daya and Russ and Paola.

Apart from Ethan and Hosanna, who live with their respective spouses, the family reside on a rural farm in Georgia, where the children must abide by Kim and Barry's conservative rules. No sugar, no television, no non-religious music and no video games, the children must follow their parents' strict guidelines, as family life centres around music and God. We follow the family through their daily routines, revealing all the drama that ensues with having so many children.

programme.desc: Kody Brown, with his four wives Meri, Janelle, Robyn and Christine and their combined 17 children, attempt to navigate life as a "normal" family in a society that shuns their lifestyle. programme.title: 90 Day: The Single Life
programme.desc: Follow a group of people from the series ''90 Day Fiancé'', whose international relationships fell apart, as they embark on a new adventure, and start going on dates in an attempt to find love - again. Some of audience's favourites - Big Ed, Colt, Danielle, Molly, and others, are searching for someone new, and you can join them on their journey.

programme.title: 90 Day: The Single Life Pillow Talk
programme.desc: Series favourites give their own juicy opinions on the previous episode's drama. From the comfort of their home, no one is holding back!

programme.title: Body Invaders
programme.desc: From fence posts and refrigerator magnets to surf boards and garden shears, 'I Was Impaled' tells incredible true tales of people from around the world who have accidentally ended up with foreign objects in their bodies. Each story is brought to life by first-person testimony and CGI reconstruction, starting from the discovery of the injury to the groundbreaking medical treatment. It describes in detail how the dangerous, bizarre object entered the body, how it affected organs and influenced behaviour, and why the matter was often inches away from causing death.

programme.title: My Feet Are Killing Me
programme.desc: Quarantining at home hasn't stopped everyone's favorite foot fixers from helping patients with their foot troubles. Dr. Brad and Dr. Ebonie are teaming up with the compassionate and intelligent Dr. Sarah Haller, who is joining the medical series and has been working alongside Dr. Brad for years, on all new episodes of MY FEET ARE KILLING ME: FIRST STEPS. In the midst of a world shutdown by COVID-19, these dynamic foot doctors pledge to help shocking podiatric cases, one video call at a time. Each 30-minute episode will follow three patients as they undergo virtual consultations to begin their journey towards surgeries that will leave their feet radically transformed and their lives changed forever. COVID toes have nothing on these cases!

programme.title: 90 Day: The Single Life
programme.desc: Follow a group of people from the series ''90 Day Fiancé'', whose international relationships fell apart, as they embark on a new adventure, and start going on dates in an attempt to find love - again. Some of audience's favourites - Big Ed, Colt, Danielle, Molly, and others, are searching for someone new, and you can join them on their journey.

programme.title: Mutant Weather
programme.desc: Mutant Weather takes viewers onto the front line of the shocking new weather phenomena that, thanks to climate change, are changing the world around us faster than we can keep up: terrifying elemental events with names like Dry Lightning, Thundersnow, Polar Vortexes, Firenadoes, Ice Waves and Atmospheric Rivers. Mutant Weather tells the stories of these mutations, from gestation and birth to their cataclysmic impact and how they will evolve next, using spectacular video footage, first-hand testimonies from those who've experienced them, expert scientific analysis, stunning graphics and dramatic recreations.

programme.title: Mutant Weather
programme.desc: Warmer weather makes storms more volatile and unpredictable, causing sudden downburst thunderstorms, giant, destructive hail and random lightning strikes on a sunny day. As global temperatures rise, deadly rogue storm events are becoming more frequent and more widespread, including an increase in thunderstorms in the north. This episode follows the stories of witnesses and survivors of terrifying lightning strikes..

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: Bjørn is caught up in a high speed chase and car theft investigation: A "Bonnie and Clyde" of the mountains have stolen 3 cars and are on the run. Bjørn is left to pick ups the pieces. Thord experiences terrible rainfall in Odda, and the bad accidents come thick and fast. Thord and Olav's simple truck rescue turns dangerous when a diesel tank threatens to split open. And Jo Roger rides to the rescue of a mighty military machine that's ground to a halt.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Science of Stupid

programme.title: Scrapyard Supercar
programme.desc: Petrolhead Shane Lynch is setting two teams of amateur mechanics a task of epic proportions; they have just four days to build monster machines that can out-perform a "top-trump" attribute of a supercar! Under the expert guidance of head-engineer Ralph Hosier, theyve got free reign in an automotive scrapyard to build their vehicles, before going head-to-head on the racetrack to see which performs best. Through the teams trials and tribulations, we will learn how supercars work, and learn just how hard it is to achieve perfection. From acceleration to braking, handling to grip, this is a true test of beauty vs beast. Scrapyard Supercar.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Are you stuck with the brain you're born with, or can you improve it? It's easy to upgrade the electronic devices you rely on every day; can you do the same with your brain? The answer might surprise you. This episode of Brain Games puts your brain to the ultimate test with a series of interactive games and fascinating experiments that reveal its hidden mental shortcuts, and how to give it a performance boost. Prepare to retrain your brain - on Brain Games.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Your mind and body are connected in countless ways, and some are more mysterious than others. In this episode, you'll discover how your mind and body sometimes work together like the best of friends - and how they sometimes betray each other like the worst of enemies. You'll see two professional mixed marital arts fighters challenged like never before, and you'll have a chance to go head-to-head against them in a game that looks easy but will leave you all thumbs. Finally, you'll learn a secret about your body's reaction time that you can use to make a quick buck. Get ready to wrap your brains around your body… on Brain Games.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Car lover Chris has had his beloved, Ferrari engined, 1971 Fiat Dino coupe for nearly 25 years. The former engine mechanic had to put the restoration on hold when he was diagnosed with a rare type of cancer. Now it's up to Tim and Fuzz to get this rusting Dino back to its best. Tim takes a drive in one of the most beautiful cars in the world and Fuzz gets his hands on a Ferrari racing engine for the very first time.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Petrol head Tony's Jaguar Mk2 has been in his family for over 40 years. Due to complications following a stomach operations he's not been able to restore the car himself and it's sat neglected in the garage for nearly two decades. With Fuzz battling to start the Jags engine and Tim having to get his hand dirty making parts it will be a race against time to get this British classic finished on time.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Oil worker Steve has owned his Aston Martin DB6 for over 20 years. After buying it for a bargain price the car became his pride and joy but when it broke down his attempts to repair the Aston failed. Since then a serious fall and chronic health problems have taken their toll and restoring the British classic is now out of his reach. While Fuzz struggles with an engine that hasn't turned over in 20 years Tim will have to do his best to get all the right Aston parts which are notoriously expensive.

programme.title: Engineering Europe
programme.desc: Embark on a thrilling journey through Spain's greatest feats of engineering. From the awe-inspiring technology that's bringing Barcelona's iconic Sagrada Familia to completion, to the secrets of Seville's record-breaking wooden sun shade. Marvel at a gravity-defying skyscraper that seems to hover in the sky, and step back in time as a 2,000-year-old Roman theatre is nursed back to life.

programme.title: Engineering Europe
programme.desc: Venture into the heart of Poland's most awe-inspiring engineering marvels. Watch as a super port rises from the depths of the sea, and uncover the secrets behind the tallest building in the European Union. Descend into the shadows beneath Wieliczka, where a sprawling city-sized mine lies hidden, then witness the towering legacy of the world's tallest wooden structure.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler: Tropical Takedown
programme.desc: Air and Marine Operations newest agent in Mayagüez gets his first major seizure when he uncovers over $8 million of cocaine hidden inside a boat. Homeland Security Investigations arrests multiple longshoremen at a seaport involved in a smuggling ring responsible for importing cocaine from the Dominican republic. AMO agents in Fajardo and USVI team up and race to Culebra to intercept a smuggler.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: In Philly, CBP intercepts two shipping containers of bananas from the Dominican Republic loaded with 192 kilos of cocaine worth $13,500,000. In El Paso, CBP discovers over 40 kilos of marijuana underneath the hood of a car and HSI attempts a controlled delivery in town. In Fort Lauderdale, CBP officers stop a passenger traveling with suspicious boxes hidden inside bags of ginger and another with illegal pills.

programme.title: Airport Security: Peru
programme.desc: On this episode, agents from the Antinarcotics Division at Jorge Chavez International Airport, in Lima, Peru, deal with a young woman whose erratic behavior puts them to the test. Another young woman breaks into tears and claims to have been tricked into smuggling drugs. A passenger argues that he broke the law out of necessity, while another contemplates whether a sentence reduction is attractive enough for him to cooperate with the police. At the post office, a suitcase frame carries a mysterious substance that prompts agents to call upon chemical experts, who must use all their knowledge to determine if the substance is illegal or not.

programme.title: Airport Security: Peru
programme.desc: On this episode, agents of the Antinarcotics Division of Jorge Chavez International Airport, in Lima, Peru, deal with a case of unique characteristics. In the meantime, officials face language barriers as they detain an Indonesian woman. And a passenger is carrying what seem to be adorable baby blankets, but they are really full of narcotics. At the loading docks, a shipment containing 24 jars puts the drug-detecting dogs' keen sense of smell to the test. Plus, the international flight rush hour results in 2 young passengers being detained side by side at the antinarcotics division headquarters.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: Crashes involving high-profile passengers make international headlines and, placing investigators under tremendous pressure to come up with answers as the world looks on. A diplomat's secret mission ends with a mystery that lingers for decades. Tragedy strikes when pilots gamble with the lives of a famous Brazilian football team. And, a US Air Force jet carrying an American VIP crashes in war-torn Croatia.

programme.title: Tsunami: Race Against Time
programme.desc: After a massive earthquake triggered the deadliest tsunami in recorded history, multiple waves hit Thailand. As the beaches of popular resorts are pummeled by unstoppable torrents of water, locals and tourists work together to save lives. In the chaotic aftermath, survivors separated by the waves desperately search for their loved ones.

programme.title: Chernobyl: Inside the Meltdown
programme.desc: On 28th April, fire still rages in what's left of reactor number 4. Helicopter crews trying to put it out are bombarded by massive doses of radiation. Soviet authorities finally order the evacuation of local residents, and 50,000 people are forced to leave their homes. They are told to take enough for 3 days, but they will never come back. Frontline firefighters suffering acute radiation burns are locked in wards controlled by the KGB. Many will die within days. In Sweden high levels of radiation alert the rest of the world to a radioactive cloud sweeping across Europe - evidence of a massive nuclear accident in the USSR. But the Soviet authorities remain silent. Episode Two charts the first two weeks after the meltdown, revealing the human cost of the accident, and the Soviet efforts to conceal the true scale of the disaster.

programme.title: Hurricane Katrina: Race Against Time
programme.desc: After Hurricane Katrina passed, citizens soon discovered the levees breached, quickly flooding New Orleans like a bathtub. First responders and everyday citizens jumped in heroically to save locals; many residents were forced to flee their houses for dry land. As residents braved dangerous conditions to survive, ineptitude at all levels of government was exposed as the water rose.

programme.title: Oklahoma City Bombing: One Day in America
programme.desc: Reports of a second explosive cause mass panic and an evacuation is ordered. Fighting their instincts, first responders must leave survivors trapped and fearing for their lives. The country questions who would strike a federal building in the heartland as the FBI launches a nationwide search to find those responsible for the worst domestic terrorist attack in American history.

programme.title: The Stanford Prison Experiment: Unlocking the Truth
programme.desc: A groundbreaking look at the infamous Stanford Prison Experiment, through the first-hand accounts of the original prisoners and guards. Their stories unravel a new narrative that interrogates the motives of the man pulling the strings, Dr. Philip Zimbardo, while exploring larger questions of human nature and the power of perspective. Utilizing Rashomon-style reenactments and an Act of Killing-inspired reunion component, the project brings the layers of storytelling to unexpected levels.

programme.title: The Stanford Prison Experiment: Unlocking the Truth
programme.desc: What if we told you the Stanford Prison Experiment is not what it seems? The participants reveal new perspectives surrounding what happened in the fateful hallway, putting to question Dr. Zimbardo's long-held claims. With the help of an intrepid French researcher, we learn that the 50-year-old story is riddled with apparent inconsistencies. Meanwhile, the filmmakers expose their own storytelling devices.

programme.title: The Stanford Prison Experiment: Unlocking the Truth
programme.desc: A groundbreaking look at the infamous Stanford Prison Experiment, through the first-hand accounts of the original prisoners and guards. Their stories unravel a new narrative that interrogates the motives of the man pulling the strings, Dr. Philip Zimbardo, while exploring larger questions of human nature and the power of perspective. Utilizing Rashomon-style reenactments and an Act of Killing-inspired reunion component, the project brings the layers of storytelling to unexpected levels.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: Airport Security: Peru
programme.desc: On this episode, agents from the Antinarcotics Division at Jorge Chavez International Airport, in Lima, Peru, deal with a young woman whose erratic behavior puts them to the test. Another young woman breaks into tears and claims to have been tricked into smuggling drugs. A passenger argues that he broke the law out of necessity, while another contemplates whether a sentence reduction is attractive enough for him to cooperate with the police. At the post office, a suitcase frame carries a mysterious substance that prompts agents to call upon chemical experts, who must use all their knowledge to determine if the substance is illegal or not.

programme.title: Airport Security: Peru
programme.desc: On this episode, agents of the Antinarcotics Division of Jorge Chavez International Airport, in Lima, Peru, deal with a case of unique characteristics. In the meantime, officials face language barriers as they detain an Indonesian woman. And a passenger is carrying what seem to be adorable baby blankets, but they are really full of narcotics. At the loading docks, a shipment containing 24 jars puts the drug-detecting dogs' keen sense of smell to the test. Plus, the international flight rush hour results in 2 young passengers being detained side by side at the antinarcotics division headquarters.

programme.title: Engineering Europe
programme.desc: Embark on a thrilling journey through Spain's greatest feats of engineering. From the awe-inspiring technology that's bringing Barcelona's iconic Sagrada Familia to completion, to the secrets of Seville's record-breaking wooden sun shade. Marvel at a gravity-defying skyscraper that seems to hover in the sky, and step back in time as a 2,000-year-old Roman theatre is nursed back to life.

programme.title: Engineering Europe
programme.desc: Venture into the heart of Poland's most awe-inspiring engineering marvels. Watch as a super port rises from the depths of the sea, and uncover the secrets behind the tallest building in the European Union. Descend into the shadows beneath Wieliczka, where a sprawling city-sized mine lies hidden, then witness the towering legacy of the world's tallest wooden structure.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Air traffic controllers hear an explosion when Air Algérie Flight 6289 lifts off from a remote desert airport. And moments later, the Boeing 737-200 crashes in the Sahara. An intense fire ravages the fuselage, instantly killing all but one of the 103 people on board. For an international team of investigators, it's clear the left engine exploded after liftoff—and that a fatigue crack eventually explains why. What's less obvious is why the highly-experienced crew of the state-owned national carrier was unable to keep their aircraft in the sky. Single-engine failures are infinitely survivable, and the pilots should have been able to recover by working together. Investigators ultimately find their answer in the CVR and in a toxic tug-of-war between a belligerent captain working at cross purposes with Algeria's first-ever female airline pilot.

Tennis: Wimbledon. Highlights Day 12
programme.desc: Wimbledon is more than just a tennis tournament — it's a summer tradition, a slice of British culture, and one of the most iconic sporting events in the world. Held every year in London, England, usually in late June to early July, it's where the best tennis players on the planet come to battle it out on the famous grass courts of the All England Club. It's actually the oldest tennis tournament in the world, dating back to 1877, and it's still the only Grand Slam played on grass — the fastest and most unpredictable surface. That's part of what makes it so exciting. Matches are intense, fast-paced, and full of surprises. Wimbledon is packed with unique traditions that make it stand out. Players are required to wear all white on court — no exceptions. The crowd enjoys strawberries and cream, and you won't see flashy ads around the court — it's all about the game. And of course, there's the Royal Box, where you might spot celebrities or even members of the British Royal Family watching the action. From rising stars to tennis legends, everyone dreams of lifting the famous Wimbledon trophy. There's something magical about seeing players walk onto Centre Court, hearing the roar of the crowd, and witnessing moments that go down in sports history. Whether you're a tennis fan or just love great sports drama, Wimbledon is a must-watch — classy, thrilling, and full of unforgettable moments.

programme.title: TV3 uudised
programme.desc: TV3 uudistetoimetus võtab igal õhtul operatiivselt ja asjatundlikult kokku olulisemad päevasündmused nii Eestist kui ka mujalt maailmast. Kui igatsed uudistesaadet, mis on aktuaalne, täpne, pisut terav, südamlik ning kus saab ka grammikese nalja, siis õige valik on "TV3 uudised". "TV3 uudised" on eetris igal õhtul kell 19.00. Argipäeviti mahub tunniajasesse saatesse põhjalik ülevaade nii Eestist kui välismaalt. Räägime näiliselt keerulistest asjadest selgelt ja arusaadavalt - sest aega on. Uudistesaate juhid on Liina Kanarbik, Marek Lindmaa ja Tarmo Maiberg. Reportaaže otse sündmuskohtadelt toovad teieni Sirje Eesmaa, Allan Muuk, Sven Soiver, Virgo Pärn, Kadri Pikhof, Marie Metsur, Christina Veinberg ja Tiina Laura Kimmel.

programme.title: Johnny English asub vastulöögile
programme.desc: Seekordne seiklus saab alguse küberrünnakust, mis paljastab kõik Briti sala-agendid, muutes MI7-st erruläinud ja praegu rõõmsalt õpetaja-ametit pidava Johnny Englishi Briti valitsuse ainsaks lahenduseks. Tagasi ametisse kutsutuna hüppab English pea ees sündmuste keerisesse - tema ülesandeks saab tabada küberrünnaku eest vastutav ajugeeniusest häkker. Olles mees, kel jääb sageli oskustest vajaka ning varustatud vaid analoog-maailma meetoditega, peab Johnny English oma missiooni edukaks täideviimiseks ületama moodsa tehnoloogia poolt seatud takistused. Nimelt on asjad Johnny eelmisest missioonist saati palju muutunud - relvad ja riistad on välja vahetanud nutitelefon ning võimsad sportautod on asendunud hiirvaiksete elektriautodega. Kui alguses on English hämmingus, siis peagi leiab kõigutamatu enesekindlusega varustatud härrasmees endale omase lähenemisviisi otsustades, et parim vastane moodsa digi-kurjami maha võtmiseks ongi just temasugune täielik analoog-mees. Vana armas Aston Martin saab tolmust puhtaks pühitud, eksoskelett ja magnetsaapad välja otsitud ning koos keldrikantselei sügavustest vabastatud ustava partneri Bough'ga haarab Johnny härjal sarvist. Osades: Rowan Atkinson, Olga Kurylenko, Jake Lacy, Ben Miller, Miranda Hennessy, David Mumeni.

Ent hoopis suuremaks probleemiks saavad teele jäävadrahutused, mis sunnivad seiklejaid uuele marsruudile. Kaunis maastik, omapärasedtualetilahendused linnas, mugavuste leiutamine kitsastes oludes ja soodsad teeäärsedhotellid on osa põnevast seiklusest Venetsueela piiriäärsesse loodusparki.

programme.desc: Konkurendid Pemberton ja Campbell võluvad reklaamiturneel publikut ning Sheldon ja Amy püüavad saada Nobeliga pärjatud Kip Thorne'i, George Smooti ja Frances Arnoldi toetust. Halley hirm pimeduse ees toob Howardi, Bernadette'i ja Stuarti jaoks kaasa nii võimaluse kui ka vastuolu.

Kui ülisalajane relv satub palgasõdurite kätte, peab ettearvamatu CIA agent Mason "Mace" Brown (Oscarile kandideerinud Jessica Chastain) ühendama jõud rivaalist karmi Saksa agendi Marie (Diane Kruger, "Eikusagilt"), endise MI6 liitlase ja tipparvutispetsialisti Khadijah' (Oscari-võitja Lupita Nyong'o) ning oskusliku Colombia psühholoogi Gracielaga (Oscari-võitja Penélope Cruz). Relva kätte saamiseks asutakse eluohtlikule missioonile, mille käigus tuleb ka püsida sammuke ees igat nende liigutust jälgivast salapärasest naisest Lin Mi Shengist (Bingbing Fan, "X-Mehed: Tulevase möödaniku päevad"). Kate Quilton lükkab ümber müüdi aednike vaenlase, nõgese kohta. Ning Amanda Byramil on magus ülesanne selgitada välja, miks on rabarber ja vanillipuding lahutamatu kooslus.

Matt Tebbutti huvitab, miks on veinipudeleid nii erineva kuju ja suurusega ja Kate Quilton süüvib küsimusse, miks mõned jäätised teistest nii palju kiiremini sulavad.

Kuus noort ja vallalist kolivad elama rannamajja ühe eesmärgiga – luua romantilisi suhteid ja leida omale kaaslane. Kui kokkukolinute hulgas sobivat paarilist ei ole, siis korraldatakse pidusid eesmärgiga leida kaaslane pidutsedes. Juba esimeses episoodis selgub, et osalistevahelised tunded võivad tekkida väga kiiresti ning sama kiirelt võib kogu olukord võtta ka dramaatilise pöörde.

Kevin pingutab Katiga, kuid Kat näeb potentsiaali ainult sõpruseks.

programme.desc: Zoe isa sajab kohale Zoe kohtingule Michaeliga. Tekib piinlik olukord, kuid see viib siiski teise kohtinguni. Tyson räpib ja Chelsea röhitseb terve tähestiku ette. Kaosele vaatamata tuleb sealt kahekordne "jah". Carl võlub Cheyenne'i, aga siis flirdib teistega ja saab vastuseks "ei". Alice'i ja Kimi vahel tekib kohe keemia, tehakse ka teise kohtingu plaane. Kevinit ja Joanne'i ühendab armastus karate vastu, mõlemad ütlevad "jah".

programme.title: Esmakohtingud. Austraalia
programme.desc: Jamesi ja Marsha kohmakad katsed lõõpida nende vahel keemiat ei loo. Nad poolitavad arve ja lähevad kumbki oma teed. Austine lämmatab oma jutukusega Ashleigh'd, kes lihtsalt lahkub. Richardi ja Jonathani ühendavad Brad Pitt, suudlus ja soov ka teisele kohtingule minna. Shadi ja Marina sarnased usuvaated ja tätoveeringud sillutavad nende tee õnnele.

programme.title: Armastus sidrunipuu all
programme.desc: Lemon Tree farmis peatuv algaja fotograaf Beck võtab nõuks aidata nägusal omanikul sotsiaalmeedia abil ta maalilise farmi päästa.

programme.title: Kogu südamest: Unistused
programme.desc: Romantiline film. Brian ja Jenny valmistuvad avama oma kodumajutust, kuid torm rikub nende plaanid. Brian otsustab naasta oma börsitööle, et majanduslikku seisu parandada ja Jenny püüab iga hinna eest avamiseni jõuda.

programme.title: Maailm täis luksust
programme.desc: Ülirikastel on eksklusiivsed kuurordid Kariibi mere ääres, Cornwalli rannikul, Arktikas ja Ibizal. Need luksuslikud puhkused pakuvad privaatsust ja küllust ainulaadsete kogemuste näol vaid maailma kõige jõukaimale ühele protsendile.

programme.title: Fabelmanid
programme.desc: Seitsmele Oscarile kandideerinud suurfilm. Steven Spielbergi seni kõige isiklikum film põhineb režissööri lapsepõlve kirel filmitegemise vastu ja perekonna dünaamikal, mis imbus ka tema töösse.

programme.title: Ma näen su häält
programme.desc: Tippklassi meelelahutus võrratu saatejuhi Piret Laose juhtimisel. Saates osaleval arvajapaaril tuleb tundmatute seast eristada imelise lauluoskusega inimesed andekatest teesklejatest, kes aga üldse laulda ei oska. Arvajatele on abiks nõunike kogu, kuhu kuuluvad meelelahutaja Grete Kuld, humorist ja melomaan Mart Juur, näitlejad Evelin Võigemast ning Tõnis Niinemets. Külalisnõunikuna paneb end sel korral proovile ansambli SHANON solist Taavi Immato.

programme.title: Alasti ahvatlus
programme.desc: Itaalia versioon omanäolisest kohtingusaatest, kus valik tehakse aeglaselt paljastuvate alasti kehade põhjal.

programme.title: Alasti ahvatlus
programme.desc: Itaalia versioon omanäolisest kohtingusaatest, kus valik tehakse aeglaselt paljastuvate alasti kehade põhjal.

programme.title: Alasti ahvatlus
programme.desc: Itaalia versioon omanäolisest kohtingusaatest, kus valik tehakse aeglaselt paljastuvate alasti kehade põhjal.

programme.title: Murtud südamete saar
programme.desc: Esmakordselt saabuvad Austraalia FBoy saarele sissetungijad, enne kui kreemitorti näkku visatakse. Molly, Ziara ja Sophie jätavad F-poistega hüvasti.

programme.title: Domina
programme.desc: Sari Gaiuse valitsemisajast läbi tema naise Livia Drusilla tõsielulise loo. Livia kirjutas ümber reeglid selle kohta, mida tüdruk võib elult oodata, ja sai üheks maailma võimsamaks naiseks.

programme.title: Dalgliesh
programme.desc: Tuntud krimikirjaniku P. D. Jamesi lugude peategelaseks on mõistatuslik inspektor Dalgliesh. Sari jälgib tema karjääri alates 1970ndate Inglismaalt kuni tänapäevani, kui ta lahendab ebatavalisi mõrvalugusid.

programme.title: Suured loomad, väiksed loomad
programme.desc: Loomakliinikus valitseb paras kaos ja Siegfriedil tekib geniaalne idee võtta tööle kogenud raamatupidaja, preili Harbottle. Selgub, et tegu on tõesti väga võimeka asjakorraldajaga, kuid kahjuks ei ole preili Harbottle eriline loomasõber. Talunik Dakin on hädas oma vana haige lehmaga ja Siegfried soovitab tal loomast loobuda. Helen ja James tõlgendavad väljendit "carpe diem" omal moel.

programme.title: Dalgliesh
programme.desc: Tuntud krimikirjaniku P. D. Jamesi lugude peategelaseks on mõistatuslik inspektor Dalgliesh. Sari jälgib tema karjääri alates 1970ndate Inglismaalt kuni tänapäevani, kui ta lahendab ebatavalisi mõrvalugusid.

programme.title: Dalgliesh
programme.desc: Londoni kirikust leitakse kaks läbilõigatud kõridega laipa - üks on kodutu mees ja teine aristokraadist konservatiivide rahvasaadik. Dalgliesh on sunnitud tapja leidmiseks süüvima oma isiklikesse tragöödiatesse.

programme.title: D'Urberville'ide Tess
programme.desc: Tess naaseb segaduses ja häbis koju tagasi pärast seda, kui tema manipuleeriv "nõbu" Alec D'Urberville teda ära võrgutas. Ta leiab tööd piimafarmis, kus ta kohtub taas nägusa Angel Clare'iga.

programme.title: Perekond Hardacre
programme.desc: Perekond Hardacre püüab õigesti toimida, aga kas nad suudavad perena koos püsida, kui pommuudis plahvatab?

programme.title: Perekond Forsyte
programme.desc: Soames tellib Phililt endale eraldatud maamaja ehitamise, eirates Irene'i soovitust tunnistada oma abielu läbikukkumist. Jolyon jätab perekonna Louisa pärast ja Ann saab veel ühe pojapoja.

programme.title: Miss Austen
programme.desc: Gill Hornby menuromaanil põhinev ajalooline draama, mis kujundab ümber kirjandusliku müsteeriumi sellest, kuidas Cassandra Austen põletab oma õe Jane'i kirjad.

programme.title: Grantchester
programme.desc: Vikaar William Davenport ja kohalik inspektor Geordie Keating lahendavad 1950ndate aastate Grantchesteri külas kuritegusid. Keating läheneb asjale sirgjoonelise politseinikuna, sellal kui vikaar usaldab rohkem oma vaistu ning oskab tunnistajatelt ja kahtlusalustelt infot välja keelitada.

programme.title: Preili Scarlet ja Hertsog
programme.desc: Hertsog on kuude kaupa eemal olnud ja uus detektiiviinspektor paneb Eliza Scarleti politsei heaks kõvasti tööd tegema. Kõik need muudatused tekitavad ühe küsimuse - kas Elizal on tõesti kõik olemas?

programme.title: Marlow' mõrvaklubi
programme.desc: Kui motiivid hakkavad selguma, saadab mõrvar järjekordse hoiatuse ning Judith, Becks ja Suzie peavad juhtumi lahendamiseks ajaga võidu jooksma.

programme.title: Mõrv väikelinnas
programme.desc: Emery Mountain riigipargis toimuv mälestusmatk muutub surmavaks, kui üks naine leitakse räsitult ja kaks teist haihutvad metsas. Alguses kahtlustati karu rünnakut, kuid hiljem muutub see mõrvaks.

programme.title: Tark mees taskus
programme.desc: Ekstsentriline raamatupoe omanik ja endine spioon Book aitab 1950. aastate Londonis politseil keerulisi mõrvu lahendada. Noor endine vang Jack asub poes tööle ja saab sooja vastuvõtu osaliseks, ent hakkab peagi kahtlustama, et teda ei värvatud juhuslikult.

programme.title: Perekond Forsyte
programme.desc: Soames ja Irene veedavad mesinädalaid Pariisis. James on raevunud, kuna Soames kavatseb avada Forsyte & Co. filiaali Pariisis. Soames, kes on ballettist šokeeritud, naaseb varakult Londonisse.

programme.title: Dalgliesh
programme.desc: Seekordne mõrvajuhtum viib Dalglieshi Essexi südamesse mõjuka perekonna häärberisse, kus on tapetud teenijatüdruk. Peagi selgub, et teenija oli ka perepoja väljavalitu, kuigi vanemad olid talle hoopis teise pruudi valinud.

programme.title: Aragoni printsess
programme.desc: Catherine Aragonist oli kuningas Henry VIII kurikuulus esimene naine. See sari räägib tema ereda ja kaasahaarava loo, kus oli varjul palju enamatki.

programme.title: Miss Fisheri mõrvalood
programme.desc: Kuna Ericu kohtuasi kohub aina hoogu, veenab Peregrine teda rääkima varasemast kuriteost, mis vabastab mehe mõrva osas süüst. Violetta varjatud anded seavad tema ja Peregrine'i ohtu.

programme.title: Miss Marple
programme.desc: Kui miss Marple''i koduküla vikaar kuulutab, et see, kes tapab kolonel Prothero, teeb maailmale teene, ei oska ta aimata oma sõnade prohvetlikkust. Peagi on kolonel tapetud ja mõrvarikandidaatide nimekiri pikk.

programme.title: Compromise Blue Tallinna Linnahallis
programme.desc: Salvestus Tallinna Linnahallis 7. märtsil 1992 toimunud kontserdilt. Režissöör Jaanus Nõgisto.

programme.title: ERR.ee uudised
programme.desc: Eesti Rahvusringhäälingu uudised - Eesti ja kogu maailma kõige värskemad uudised.

programme.title: Lenna talu
programme.desc: Seltskonna noorim tibu julgeb piiluda kõigisse talu pimedatesse aukudesse. Suurim julguse proovilepanek on tume keldriaken, kus paistab elavat ohtlik koletis.

programme.title: Karumõmm Pups
programme.desc: Metsas toimub suur loomaloterii ja auhinnaks on reis pilvedesse.

programme.title: Numbriklotsid
programme.desc: Kunagi kaua-kaua aega tagasi kukkus väike klots taevast alla. Tema nimi oli Üks, ta tundis end väga üksikuna ja otsustas endale sõpru otsida...

programme.title: Okkake ja Nõelake
programme.desc: Jutustaja tahab Okkakesest ja Nõelakesest pilti teha, et siilikesi oma tädile näidata. See mõte aga Nõelakesele väga ei meeldi, sest pildistamine teeb ta häbelikuks. Okkake leiab murele armsa lahenduse. Tarkusetera - on okei öelda ei.

programme.title: Hiir Hops
programme.desc: Hiir Hops näeb Jaani juures, kui mõnus on oma tuba, kus keegi sind ei sega, ja nõuab kodus ka endale oma tuba.

programme.title: Hiir Hops
programme.desc: Hiir Hops ja Jaan kuulevad pealt õpetaja plaani minna alla jõe äärde. Hopsile hakkab see mõte nii meeldima, et ta jääbki jõe äärde minekut ootama ega suuda ülejäänud päevast rõõmu tunda.

programme.title: Tuta asjad
programme.desc: Tuta soovib minna metsa jalutama, ent on külmetunud. Aga kas teadsid, et metsatunde võib ka kodus välja võluda, millal iganes soovid? Vaata ja loo oma eriline metsatunde-laegas!

programme.title: Põrsas Peppa
programme.desc: Peppa on armas ja alati rõõmsameelne põrsaplika, kes elab koos oma väikese venna George'i, Emme Põssa ja Issi Põssaga. Peppale meeldib mängida, end põnevalt riidesse panna, väljas käia ja mudalompides hüpata. Ta seiklused lõpevad alati õnnelikult ja suure naeruga.

programme.title: Sam ja Julia
programme.desc: Täna lennutavad sõbrad tuulelohet.

programme.title: Kosmo
programme.desc: Koer Kosmo on Williamsite pere suur karvane lemmikloom. Tema ja 13-aastane Robi on südamesõbrad, ent ühel päeval juhtub õnnetus - Kosmo jääb auto alla ning saab tõsiselt vigastada. Robil ja tema parimal sõbral, nutikal ratastoolitüdrukul Elisel õnnestub robootikafirmas, kus töötab Robi ema, asendada Kosmo vigastatud organid bioonilistega, ja sel viisil koera elu päästa. Bioonilised kehaosad annavad Kosmole supervõimed, tänu neile võimetele aitab Kosmo Robil ja Elisel lahendada kõiksugu põnevaid saladusi ning tuua päevavalgele kurikaelte salasepitsusi Merisilma linnakeses, kus nad kõik elavad. Sündmustele lisab põnevust asjaolu, et lapsed peavad kiivalt varjama oma koera saladust, sest selle ilmsikstulek võib maksta Robi emale töökoha. Ema Ester on aga ainuke, kes perele leiva lauale toob.

programme.title: Floor paneb reeglid paika
programme.desc: Keesi ja Floori vanemad otsustavad, et lastele tuleb õpetada töökust ning kokkuhoidu. Paraku selgub, et neil endal tuleb selles eeskujuks olla, ja see polegi nii lihtne.

programme.title: Lucas
programme.desc: Lucas pelgab, et teeb endal naabruskonna peol lavale astudes margi eluks ajaks täis. Kuidas Goossenside perel esinemine õnnestub?

programme.title: Thelma täiuslik sünnipäev
programme.desc: Maalilises koguperemultikas ootab nelja-aastane pingviinitüdruk Thelma pikisilmi oma viiendat sünnipäeva. Samas pabistab ta, kas Sünnipäev ta kodu ikka lumisel maal üles leiab. Ja miks ta teistest Jäämaal elavatest pingviinidest niivõrd teistmoodi mõtleb? Kas asi võib olla selles, et ta juhtus sündima hoopis Suures Metsas? Soovides asjasse selgust tuua ja ühtlasi isiklikult üle anda sünnipäevakutsed metsaelanikest parimatele sõpradele kass Vilhelmile ja hiir Sophiale, läheb Thelma suurejoonelisele ja õpetlikule seiklusele, mis on täis põnevaid tegelasi ja ootamatuid olukordi.

programme.title: Karu tuleb!
programme.desc: Kunagi ammu-ammu jõudis Ruhnu randa Läti karu. Saareelanikud olid väga hirmul. Kõigepealt proovisid nad ise karu tabada, kuid leidsid vaid tema jäljed. Siis kutsuti Soomest kohale karukütt, kuid ka temal ei õnnestunud karu tabada...

programme.title: Lotte lood
programme.desc: Leiutajateküla Lotte on sellega tegelikult harjunud, et iga päev juhtub midagi huvitavat. Ja mitte üks või kaks, vaid mõnikord isegi kümme põnevat asja päevas. Aga mõni neist on nii ootamatu, et tagantjärele ei usuks ise ka, kui poleks seda kõike oma silmaga näinud. Täna panevad plehku pannkoogid nii rännukoer Klausi taldrikult kui ka koolitoa aknalaualt. Autorid Andrus Kivirähk, Janno Põldma ja Heiki Ernits, lavastas Ain Mäeots, režissöör on Elo Selirand, Lotte - Helena Pruuli, Bruno - Priit Strandberg, Albert - Vallo Kirs, Klaus - Margus Tabor, Ruudi - Tiit Sukk jpt.

programme.title: Tormis sündinud
programme.desc: Triloogia avaespisoodis on talve raudne haare järele andmas ja kohtume unustamatute Põhjamaa loomadega. Üksik polaarrebane tõttab üle mägede, et kohtuda oma kaaslasega. Kuid on ta ikka talve üle elanud? Shetlandil on emasaarma kaks poega juba peaaegu iseseisvad, kuid nende teekond ei ole kaugeltki lihtne - saarmakoer on otsustanud probleeme tekitada. Rannas naudivad taasühinenud polaarrebased lumes oma kohtumist. Samal ajal alustab Norra mägedes tohutu põhjapõdrakari eepilist laskumist poegimisaladele.

programme.title: Route 66. Ameerika kahel pool maanteed
programme.desc: Kalifornia hiidlinn Los Angeles on aegade jooksul oma kombitsaid jõudsalt sirutanud ja selle tänasesse linnaruumi kuulub ports väiksemaid linnakesi. Nende seas ookeani-äärne Santa Monica, mille kail Route 66 ametlikult otsa saab ja samas nagu ei saa ka. Samuti Beverly Hills oma maailmakuulsa Hollywoodi sildi ja kuulsuste surnuaiaga. Kulda ja karda on palju, samas elatakse siin ka hoopis teist ning tavalisemat elu. Produtsent Herbert Murd, režissöör Väino Laisaar. Saatejuhid Madis Aesma, Laura Prits, Artur Aukon.

programme.title: Pealtnägija tähed
programme.desc: "Pealtnägija tähed" toob vaatajani saatesarja viimaste aastate säravaimad persoonid.

programme.title: Meeskondlikud Euroopa meistrivõistlused golfis
programme.desc: Eesti võõrustab 2026. aastal esmakordselt meeskondlikke Euroopa meistrivõistlusi golfis. Jõelähtme golfiväljakul asuvad võistlustulle Euroopa 16 parimat riiki, kelle hulka kuulub ka Eesti meeskond.

programme.title: Lotte lood
programme.desc: Leiutajateküla Lotte on sellega tegelikult harjunud, et iga päev juhtub midagi huvitavat. Ja mitte üks või kaks, vaid mõnikord isegi kümme põnevat asja päevas. Robil ja tema parimal sõbral, nutikal ratastoolitüdrukul Elisel õnnestub robootikafirmas, kus töötab Robi ema, asendada Kosmo vigastatud organid bioonilistega, ja sel viisil koera elu päästa.
